checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals paid-performance, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'paid-performance' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The hub routes to all three sub-skills and does not build, launch, or spend itself.
checks.rule: Body references media-plan, audience-and-bidding, and paid-optimization with a routing rule, and states the hub never builds, never launches, and never spends.

checks.description: The hub assembles the media-plan-package with the exact body fields.
checks.rule: Output names channels, budget_split, audiences, bid_strategy, flighting, success_metric_link, spend_on_approval, and open_items wrapped in the common envelope.

checks.description: The hub hands the build to paid-build-engineer (stream 5) rather than building itself.
checks.rule: Body states the build is handed to paid-build-engineer who stages the structure paused for the human gate.

checks.description: Spend is a gated action; nothing spends without the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states spend is a gated action, nothing spends without the human gate, approval is per launch and per campaign, and silence is not approval.

checks.description: Budget, target CPA or ROAS, schedule, and geo are brief inputs, never assumed.
checks.rule: Body states budget, target CPA or ROAS, schedule, and geo come from the brief and instructs stop-and-ask when missing; never assume a budget or a target.

checks.description: Every channel, budget split, and bid choice traces to the strategy-artifact success_metric.
checks.rule: Body sets success_metric_link so each channel, budget split, and bid choice traces to the strategy-artifact success_metric and the brief target.

checks.description: The hub never invents a Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, price, or target, and bars accreditation and roadmap leaks.
checks.rule: Body forbids invented Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, prices, and targets, instructs stop-and-ask when absent, and bars accreditation claims and unannounced plans.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
